name: Good Culture Organic Whole Milk Classic Cottage Cheese
whyItWorks: Made without chemical stabilizers, guar gums, carrageenan, or added thickeners—only organic skim milk, cream, sea salt, and live active cultures. The clean ingredient deck prevents the cramping often triggered by commercial emulsifiers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat plain or with scrambled eggs. Take a lactase tablet if sensitive to dairy sugars.
